'''Camp Kavel''' was a military encampment that was established on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pleida]].

==History==
During a conflict on Pleida, one faction forced the other to retreat and established Camp Kavel in the evacuated zone. However, a number of their command officers were injured, so the surgeon [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Pleth Juun]] was sent to travel to the camp and treat them. However, the advancing side did not have air superiority in the area, so they couldn't fly Juun in and instead, a group of agents were assigned to escort her there.
